children: Oil prices climb more than 4% in afternoon U.S. trade after a Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said Saudi Arabia intercepted six ballistic missiles ​fired by Iran-backed Houthis on Thursday. A Houthi military spokesman said in a statement that the group had launched dozens of ballistic missiles and drones against Saudi military sites in Jazan. The Saudi Civil Defense separately issued an emergency warning in Mecca to alert of a potential danger. The front-month Brent crude contract rises 4.7% to $107.95 a barrel, while WTI futures are up 4.8% to $96.56 a barrel. (giulia.petroni@wsj.com)
